TOMISLAV MESARIĆ
Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant

[PHONE] | [EMAIL]

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Butcher-trained meat counter professional with four years of customer service experience at Dolac Market Hall. Experienced in weighing and pricing orders, operating a till, maintaining clean equipment and rotating cold-room stock using FIFO. Additional hands-on experience preparing whole lambs and suckling pigs, developing fresh sausage products and recording temperature and weight-loss data during a dry-ageing trial. Basic HACCP knowledge.

KEY SKILLS
• Meat counter service and customer advice
• Weighing, pricing and till operation
• Cold-room stock rotation (FIFO)
• Preparation of whole lambs and suckling pigs
• Fresh sausage preparation and product development
• Cleaning slicers, mincers and counter areas
• Basic HACCP knowledge and hygiene routines
• Customer-facing English

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Meat Counter Assistant / Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante, Dolac Market Hall
Current role | Four years of meat-counter customer service
• Serve customers and weigh and price their orders; operate the till.
• Rotate cold-room stock every morning, placing older stock at the front.
• Clean slicers and the mincer each evening.
• Prepare whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting orders, including butchering, seasoning and delivery.

SELECTED PROJECTS
Shop Sausage Range | Mesnica Kod Ante | 2020–Present
• Developed the shop’s lamb merguez recipe and adjusted the ćevapi mix to 70% beef and 30% lamb following customer feedback.
• The ćevapi received second place at the Zagreb County craft meat fair (Sajam mesnih proizvoda) in 2023.
• Make approximately 40 kg of fresh sausage per week during the busy season.

Wedding and Party Catering | Mesnica Kod Ante | 2022–2025
• Prepared, butchered, seasoned and delivered whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting at three weddings and approximately ten family parties per year.
• Prepared an order of four lambs and two pigs for a 180-guest wedding in Samobor in 2024.

Dry-Aged Beef Trial | Mesnica Kod Ante | 2024
• Ran a six-week trial of dry-ageing beef ribs for 21 and 28 days in a rented cabinet; recorded weight loss and temperature.
• The shop now sells dry-aged rib by pre-order, at approximately 15 kg per month.

Stall Closing Routine | Tržnica Dolac Meat Hall | 2017
• Wrote a one-page closing and cleaning checklist for the slicer, mincer, counter and floor drain following a hygiene inspection remark. The checklist remains in use at the stall.

EDUCATION & TRAINING
Butcher Training | Food Trades School | 2015
HACCP | Basic knowledge
Master Butcher Exam (Majstorski Ispit) | Preparing; exam planned for spring 2027

LANGUAGES
English | Good for customer service

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, focused CV for the role. It clearly presents butcher training, four years of meat-counter experience, customer service, weighing and pricing, till operation, FIFO stock rotation, hygiene routines, whole-animal preparation, sausage production, and relevant temperature-recording experience. The project section adds credible detail and measurable evidence, including approximately 40 kg of sausage per week, a 180-guest wedding order, a 2023 competition result, and approximately 15 kg of dry-aged beef sold per month. The structure is easy to scan and the tone is professional. The main content weaknesses are the lack of actual employment dates, the use of placeholder contact details, and one potentially unsupported claim regarding customer advice.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The CV uses conventional section headings, plain text, bullet points, and a chronological experience structure that should parse well in ATS systems. It includes important job-ad terms such as butcher, meat counter, weighing, pricing, till, FIFO, HACCP, temperature records, cleaning, and customer service. ATS alignment would improve by adding explicit dates for the current role and using the exact phrase "HACCP knowledge" while retaining the accurate qualifier "basic." The document does not claim a forklift licence, which is correct. It also does not falsely claim supermarket, tray-sealer, self-service packaging, or advanced HACCP experience. The AI-screening probability is high for the listed must-have requirements, though the missing contact details would make the CV unusable if they remain placeholders.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The document shows an excellent match for the two mandatory requirements: completed butcher training and more than two years of meat-counter experience, plus basic HACCP knowledge. It aligns well with FreshCart's emphasis on fresh food, knowledgeable customer service, hygiene, FIFO rotation, reliability, and practical experience. Whole-lamb and suckling-pig preparation, sausage development, dry-ageing records, and the cleaning checklist strengthen the practical profile. Alignment is weaker for duties not supported by the candidate's material: supermarket self-service packaging, tray-sealer use, labelling scales, and maintaining self-service shelves. The candidate has no forklift licence, so the nice-to-have requirement is a gap. HACCP is described as basic rather than advanced, and the CV does not show direct supermarket experience. These are candidate-background gaps, not defects in the CV wording.
critique.improvement_instructions:
CRITICAL:
1. Before submitting the CV, replace "[PHONE] | [EMAIL]" in the header with the candidate's actual phone number and professional email address. Do not submit the document with placeholders.
2. In the Key Skills section, change "Meat counter service and customer advice" to "Meat counter customer service and order handling" unless the candidate can substantiate providing advice on cuts, quantities, or preparation. The original candidate information confirms customer service but does not explicitly confirm customer advice; this change prevents an unsupported claim.

MINOR:
3. In the Professional Experience section under "Mesnica Kod Ante, Dolac Market Hall," replace "Current role | Four years of meat-counter customer service" with actual dates if available, using a format such as "[Month Year]–Present | Four years of meat-counter customer service." Dates will improve ATS parsing and recruiter confidence.
4. In the Professional Summary, change "Basic HACCP knowledge" to "Basic HACCP knowledge and food-hygiene routines" only if retaining the same meaning; alternatively leave the wording as-is but ensure the phrase "HACCP knowledge" appears exactly in the summary or Key Skills section. Do not imply HACCP team-leader or advanced HACCP experience.
5. In the Professional Experience section, consider changing "Prepare whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting orders, including butchering, seasoning and delivery" to "Prepare, butcher, season and deliver whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting orders." This uses the job-relevant action "butcher" more directly without adding unsupported experience.
critique.critical_issues:
1. The header contains placeholder contact details: "[PHONE] | [EMAIL]". This must be corrected before submission.
2. "Customer advice" may be an unsupported embellishment. The original candidate information confirms serving customers but does not explicitly confirm advising customers on cuts, quantities, or preparation. Revise or substantiate this wording.
Claims the sources (the candidate's own material; for the employer, the job ad and company research) do not support:
- Customer advice

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, well-structured CV with clear relevance to a butcher and meat-counter role. It presents customer service, weighing and pricing, till operation, FIFO stock rotation, equipment cleaning, whole-animal preparation, sausage production and dry-ageing experience with useful evidence and quantities. The project section adds credibility and impact, particularly the award, 40 kg weekly sausage production and the 180-guest wedding order. The document is professional and truthful against the supplied candidate information. The main content weaknesses are the lack of contact details and the somewhat informal/non-standard employment date line.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: ATS compatibility is strong. The CV uses conventional section headings, plain bullet points, readable role titles and relevant keywords including butcher, meat counter, customer service, weighing, pricing, till, FIFO, HACCP, slicer, mincer, sausage preparation, temperature and stock rotation. It should have a high probability of passing an initial ATS or AI screening for this vacancy because it directly reflects the two must-have requirements. For maximum parsing reliability, use standard date formatting and include actual phone and email details in the header. The Croatian terms and special characters should generally be acceptable, but the English keyword equivalents already present are helpful.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The CV aligns very well with FreshCart's core requirements and culture. Completed butcher training and more than two years of meat-counter experience are clearly shown, as is basic HACCP knowledge. The experience demonstrates reliable hygiene routines, FIFO rotation, customer-facing work, fresh sausage production and pride in product quality. The document also gives relevant evidence of recording temperature and weight-loss data during a dry-ageing trial. Forklift licence is a gap: the candidate's notes state that they have no forklift licence, although they have used a hand pallet jack. The CV does not demonstrate supermarket self-service packaging, tray-sealer or labelling-scale experience, or maintaining a stated 95% peak-hours stock level; these are role-alignment limitations rather than defects in the document. The candidate's practical butcher experience remains a strong match for the advertised position.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR IMPROVEMENTS:
1. In the header, add the candidate's actual phone number, email address and current professional contact details if available. Do not insert placeholder or invented information. This is important because the current CV has no direct contact method for the employer.
2. In the Professional Experience heading for “Meat Counter Assistant / Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante, Dolac Market Hall,” replace “Current role | Four years of meat-counter customer service” with a standard date-and-duration format such as “Present | 4 years’ experience” or, if the exact start date is known, “YYYY–Present | 4 years.” This will improve ATS date parsing without inventing an employment date.
3. In the Education & Training section, change “HACCP | Basic knowledge” to “HACCP | Basic knowledge; temperature-recording and hygiene routines” only if the wording accurately reflects the routines already described elsewhere in the CV. Do not imply completion of a HACCP course or team-leader qualification.
